fusions.name: Tasting Flick
fusions.desc: A quick lash that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Sapping Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a glob that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and stuns it for 1.2 seconds. It has a 50% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 5 seconds, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Warmed Through
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 12 seconds. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Gone Still
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
